hints: Look closely at the organic product on the right hand side and work out what functional group it contains.
Notice that $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO}$ is propanal, an aldehyde with no $\text{CH}_3\text{CO}$ group, so think about which reagents oxidise aldehydes.
Recall which test needs a methyl carbonyl group for a yellow precipitate, and check whether propanal can meet that requirement.
walkthrough:
**Identify the organic product**

Look at the right hand side of the equation. The only carbon containing product is $2\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO}$.

This is propanal:
$$\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO}$$
It contains the aldehyde group, $-\text{CHO}$.

**Check tests 1 and 2, the oxidising tests**

Aldehydes are easily oxidised to carboxylic acids. Both Tollens reagent and acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$ are oxidising agents.

Tollens: $\text{Ag}^+$ reduced to silver mirror. $\text{MnO}_4^-$: purple colour decolourised:
$$\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO} + [O] \rightarrow \text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{COOH}$$
So 1 and 2 are both positive.

**Check test 3, the iodoform test**

Warming with alkaline aqueous iodine is the triiodomethane (iodoform) test for the group $\text{CH}_3\text{CO}-$ or $\text{CH}_3\text{CH(OH)}-$.

Propanal is $\text{CH}_3\text{CH}_2\text{CHO}$. It has an ethyl group next to $\text{CHO}$, not a methyl group next to $\text{C=O}$, so no yellow $\text{CHI}_3$ precipitate forms. So 3 is negative.

**Combine the conclusions**

Statements 1 and 2 are correct, statement 3 is incorrect. That corresponds to 1 and 2 only.

options.A: Incorrect. This option claims 1, 2 and 3 are all positive. While 1 and 2 are correct for propanal, 3 is wrong because propanal does not contain the $\text{CH}_3\text{CO}$ group needed for the iodoform reaction.
options.B: Correct. Propanal is an aldehyde, so it gives a silver mirror with Tollens reagent (1) and decolourises acidified $\text{KMnO}_4$ on oxidation to propanoic acid (2), but it gives no iodoform precipitate with alkaline iodine (3).
options.C: Incorrect. This option claims 2 and 3 only. Test 2 is indeed positive, but test 3 is negative for propanal, and test 1 has been wrongly left out since all aldehydes reduce Tollens reagent.
options.D: Incorrect. This option claims 1 only. Test 1 is positive, but test 2 is also positive because aldehydes are readily oxidised by acidified manganate(VII). It is incomplete to choose 1 alone.
